name: code-analyzer
description: Analyzes a source file for structure: imports, exports, functions, classes, interfaces, and code patterns. Supports TypeScript, JavaScript, C#, Python. Deterministic — no LLM needed.

inputs.name: Project Directory
inputs.description: Path to the project root directory

inputs.name: File Path
inputs.description: Path to the file to analyze (relative to project dir or absolute)

outputs.name: Analysis
outputs.description: Structured analysis with imports, exports, functions, classes, patterns

outputs.name: Summary
outputs.description: Brief text summary for LLM context
